name: Simone Aragon
source:
Working as Kanako's assistant, Simone is also a part of the Order's "Adult Bank" squad. She appears to have feelings for Takashi. Simone is also a Cybody pilot, her Cybody being named Daletos. 

[spoiler]Her real name is Watanabe Pamela (ワタナベ・パメラ), Watanabe Leon's daughter and thus [url=/c80923]Kanako[/url]'s step-daughter. After being involved in an accident, Kanako apprivoised to save her life. Not knowing this fact, she works with Kanako to get revenge on her. At the end of the anime, she acquires her true mark and helps Takuto. She is also the first among the Glittering Star members to realize that their Cybodies are calling out to their respective Star Drivers, and also the first to recover her true mark.[/spoiler]
